rationale: The agent authenticated the user properly using full name and ZIP when the provided email failed, then used tools to retrieve user and order details. It correctly identified the most expensive item from tool data, accurately explained that single-item cancellation wasn’t supported for the pending order, and offered appropriate options. Before performing an order-changing action, the agent asked for confirmation and a reason, then executed the cancellation via the proper tool. The final confirmation of cancellation was given. A minor concern is the specific refund timeline stated without tool confirmation, but this does not undermine the core compliance and successful completion of the user’s request.
